fieldDescriptions.writeKind: 0 protected write,1 no write,2 write without unlock,3 expired unlock
fieldDescriptions.requestedDivCode: Target CLKPS exponent0..8, including ignored/no-write controls
fieldDescriptions.clkprReadback: Raw CLKPR snapshot before or after the marker window; not a timestamp of waveform switching
fieldDescriptions.tccr0a: Raw observer TCCR0A; configured COM0A0|WGM01, OC0B disconnected
fieldDescriptions.tccr0b: Raw observer TCCR0B; configured CS00 and WGM02=0

records.meaning: pre/boot snapshot after initial divider and CTC observer settle
post snapshot after marker pulse and32 NOPs

stimulus.source: continuous external square wave at measured1MHz, approximately50percent duty,0..VCC
stimulus.start: CLKI present and stable before RESET release
stimulus.stop: Keep CLKI running through the marker pulse, post frame and final observation
stimulus.repetitions: Run each profile from reset; retain repeated independent captures

recording.columnUnits: time_s seconds; clock/data/clki/oc0a/marker binary; reset/vcc actual measured volts
recording.frameTimestamps: Transport timestamps only; infer timing from retained physical marker/OC0A/CLKI waveforms
recording.conditions: Record actual fuse readback, chip marking/revision, package, measured VCC/temperature/source frequency and instrument timing uncertainty
recording.hashes: Retain SHA256 of firmware source, shared probe-wire.inc, generated definitions, manufacturer provenance, build defines/toolchain, ELF/programmed image and original capture files

note: Source-only measurement firmware. CTC observer startup, pad propagation and instrument uncertainty must be distinguished from hidden prescaler/bus phases. No hardware trace has been collected.
